parse_context_references: parse @ references in a message string and return a list of ContextReference objects with kind, target, and line range
preprocess_context_references: preprocess a message by expanding @file, @folder, @diff, @staged, @git, and @url references into injected context blocks with token limits
expand_file_reference: expand a @file reference by reading a file, optionally extracting a line range, and wrapping it in a fenced code block with language detection
expand_folder_reference: expand a @folder reference by building a tree listing of visible files and directories with line counts and size metadata
expand_git_reference: expand a @diff, @staged, or @git reference by running a git command and formatting the output as a fenced diff block
